fusions.name: Shod Hoof
fusions.desc: A steel-shod kick that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Clangour
fusions.desc: Slams your plated flank down so that it rings, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Plated Flank
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Bolted Barding
fusions.desc: Conjures steel barding over your hide: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, your maximum health rises by 12, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
